title: Antibody drug conjugates and methods for making thereof
abstract: ANTIBODY DRUG CONJUGATES AND METHODS FOR MAKING THEREOF ABSTRACT This application discloses microorganisms and methods of producing GNAQ/GNAl l inhibitors and methods of making antibody drug conjugates of anti PMEL17 antibodies or antigen binding fragments conjugated to a GNAQ/GNAl l inhibitor. The disclosure also relates to formulations comprising antibody drug conjugates of anti-PMEL17 antibodies or antigen binding fragments conjugated to a GNAQ/GNAl l inhibitor and methods of treating or preventing cancer using the formulations.

title: Compositions and methods for identifying and treating microparticle-associated diseases and conditions
abstract: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for identifying and treating signature MP-associated diseases and conditions in subjects. In particular, treatment methods of the invention include administering a gelsolin agent to produce a therapeutic effect against a signature MP-associated disease or condition in a subject.

title: Multispecific and multifunctional molecular and use of the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide used in cancer treatment. SOLUTION: A multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide includes: (i) a tumor targeting portion binding to cancer antigen, which is a first tumor targeting portion for example; (ii) an immunocyte engager selected from an NK-cell engager, a T-cell engager, a B-cell engager, a dendritic cell engager or a macrophage cell engager; (iii) cytokine molecules; and (iv) two or all of interstitial adjustment portions. title: Compositions and methods for capture of cellular targets of bioactive agents
abstract: The present invention provides compositions and methods for capture and identification of the cellular targets of a bioactive agent. In particular, provided herein are bioactive agents tethered to capture ligand, cellular targets (optionally tagged with a reporter), capture proteins (optionally present as capture fusions), surfaces (e.g., displaying, capture ligands, capture proteins, or capture fusions), and methods of capturing and identifying the cellular targets of a bioactive agent therewith.

title: Compounds and uses thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for the treatment of BAF-related disorders, such as cancers and viral infections.

title: Transfer substrate, electronic device and manufacturing method of transfer substrate
abstract: To provide a transfer substrate capable of improving a yield, an electronic device and a manufacturing method of the transfer substrate.SOLUTION: A transfer substrate comprises: a substrate including a first top face; a conductive film which is provided on the substrate and includes a second top face; and a first insulator film which is provided on the substrate and directly in contact with the conductive film and includes a third top face continued to the second top face. The second top face and the third top face are tilted from the first top face in a boundary between the second top face and the third top face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Semiconductor device and method for fabricating the same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a substrate, a first wiring pattern on an upper surface of the substrate, and a second wiring pattern on the upper surface of the substrate. The first wiring pattern includes a first crystal and a second crystal adjacent to the first crystal in a horizontal direction. A crystal orientation of each of the first crystal and the second crystal is in a vertical direction perpendicular to the upper surface of the substrate. An interface between the first crystal and the second crystal extends in the vertical direction. The second wiring pattern is spaced apart from the first wiring pattern in the horizontal direction.

title: Apparatus and method for measuring modified area of substrate
abstract: To provide a substrate reforming area measuring device.SOLUTION: The imaging apparatus includes a first imaging device 101, a second imaging device 102, a third imaging device 103, and a microcomputer unit 104. The first imaging device faces the first surface of the substrate 110 and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a first image. The second imaging device faces the second surface of the substrate and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a second image. The first surface of the substrate is opposite to the second surface of the substrate. The third imaging device obliquely faces the first surface of the substrate or the second surface of the substrate, and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a third image. The micro-processor unit obtains a modified area measurement information of at least one modified area of the substrate according to the first image, the second image and the third image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Light-emitting device having multiple curved regions
abstract: A light-emitting device or a display device that is less likely to be broken is provided. Provided is a light-emitting device including an element layer and a substrate over the element layer. At least a part of the substrate is bent to the element layer side. The substrate has a light-transmitting property and a refractive index that is higher than that of the air. The element layer includes a light-emitting element that emits light toward the substrate side. Alternatively, provided is a light-emitting device including an element layer and a substrate covering a top surface and at least one side surface of the element layer. The substrate has a light-transmitting property and a refractive index that is higher than that of the air. The element layer includes a light-emitting element that emits light toward the substrate side.

title: Hybrid element substrate and method of fabricating the same
abstract: Provided is a method of fabricating a hybrid element substrate, the method including forming a plurality of first elements on a first substrate which is a silicon substrate or a silicon-on-insulator (SOI) substrate; forming a plurality of second elements on a second substrate which has a material different from a material of the first substrate; separating a plurality of second elements from the second substrate; primarily transferring the plurality of second elements onto a transfer substrate comprising a plurality of grooves by a fluidic self-assembly method such that the plurality of second elements are arranged in the plurality of grooves of the transfer substrate, respectively; and secondarily transferring, onto the first substrate, the plurality of second elements transferred onto the transfer substrate such that the plurality of second elements are next to the first elements on the first substrate and spaced apart from each other, or overlap upper portions of the first elements, respectively.

title: Falling prevention apparatus and image forming apparatus
abstract: A falling prevention apparatus includes: a falling prevention member: attached to a target apparatus; and protruding outward from a side face of the target apparatus with a protrusion amount in a protruding direction; and a protrusion amount changer to change the protrusion amount.

title: Metal plate connecting method
abstract: To provide a metal plate connecting method which can rigidly and accurately connect even metal plates that are made from different kinds of materials from each other.SOLUTION: A metal plate connecting method of the present invention includes: forming a through-hole at the same locations on a plurality of metal plates vertically stacked on each other; inserting into the through-hole a plug having a cross-sectional shape approximately equal to the cross-sectional shape of the through-hole and having a higher hardness than both of the metal plates; pressurizing the periphery of the plug at least on the surfaces of outermost two metal plates of the stacked metal plates and causing the metal plates to plastically deform in a surface direction of the plug to apply a fastening stress to the plug, thereby connecting the plurality of metal plates to each other through the plug.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Impeller attachment/detachment jig for magnet pump, and impeller attachment/detachment device comprising the same
abstract: To provide an impeller attachment/detachment jig for a magnet pump that allows a worker to simply and safely facilitate attachment/detachment work without touching it directly.SOLUTION: An impeller attachment/detachment jig for a magnetic pump is composed of: a substantially cylindrical base shaft part 11; arm parts 12 to 14 provided radially on an outer peripheral surface of the base shaft part 11 at equal intervals in a circumferential direction; a weight prat 15 located in a direction opposite to a direction in which the arm parts 12 to 14 extend with respect to the base shaft part 11; and a connection part 16 that connects the base shaft part 11 and the weight part 15 to each other. The arm parts 12 to 14 are bent so that their terminal parts face toward a central axis O from three directions with center angles shifted by 120 degrees on the same plane perpendicular to the central axis O of the base shaft part 11. The arm parts 13, 14 have their terminal parts expandable and retractable in a direction away from the central axis O.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title: Control system, processing apparatus, and method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract: To provide a technology for supplying a raw material with a low vapor pressure to a process chamber while controlling the flow rate.SOLUTION: There is provided a technique that includes a flow-rate controller including a regulator configured to be capable of regulating a flow rate of a gas; and a controller configured to be capable of switching between a first mode of the flow-rate controller in which the flow rate of the gas is regulated to a predetermined flow rate through operation of the regulator, and a second mode of the flow-rate controller in which the regulator is set to be in a full open state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Exchange jig and image formation device
abstract: To improve workability in exchange of a flexible flat cable.SOLUTION: An image formation device includes: a photoreceptor; an exposure head which has a connector, forms a shape elongated in an axial direction of the photoreceptor, and exposes the photoreceptor; a control board; a flexible flat cable configured to electrically connect the connector with the control board; and a guide member which is provided extending in a lateral direction of the image formation device and holds the flexible flat cable along the lateral direction. An exchange tool is used to exchange the flexible flat cable in the image formation device. The exchange tool has a sheet member forming an elongated shape. The sheet member has, at one end side in a longitudinal direction, a cable holding part which holds the flexible flat cable. A length from the cable holding part to the other end in the longitudinal direction is, through the guide member, a length such that the other end is exposed from a first through hole disposed at one side in the lateral direction, and the cable holding part is exposed from a second through hole disposed at the other side in the lateral direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 48

title: Controlled release nutraceutical carrier and its manufacturing
abstract: A manufacturing process comprising vacuum assisted extraction coupled to ultrasound treatment of food by-products to obtain a controlled release agent comprising polysaccharides and polysaccharide bonded phenols is provided. A manufacturing process for food by-products comprising 3 cycles of vacuum instantaneous expansion, 15 minutes of ultrasound assisted extraction and pH of 1.5 to obtain polysaccharides with an increased range of antioxidant activity and a decreased zeta potential is also provided. A controlled release medicine comprising the controlled release agent obtained from the manufacturing processes is provided wherein the controlled release medicine comprises an active substance or beneficial microorganisms. The active agent may be selected from analgesics, antihistamines, digestives, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory agents, polyphenolic extracts, carotenoids, cannabinoids, and vitamins. The beneficial microorganism may be selected from Lactobacillus, Saccharomyces, Bifidobacterium, Streptococcus or Akkermansia. The bonded phenols may be gallic acid or polyphenols. The polysaccharide may be cellulose and hemicellulose. The food by-product is preferable persimmon (Diospyros kaki Thunb). [Fig: None]

title: Multifunctional catalyst, producing method thereof and use method thereof
abstract: To provide a multifunctional catalyst used for recycling polyester fabric, a producing method thereof, and a use method thereof.SOLUTION: A multifunctional catalyst 100 includes a carrier S, a first functional ionic liquid IL-1 and a second functional ionic liquid IL-2 grafted onto the carrier. The carrier is an inorganic composite powder material and is composed of a chemical component shown as C:Na-Ni/Al2O3. During recycling of polyester fabric, multifunctional catalysts can simultaneously decolorize and depolymerize polyester textiles. The first functional ionic liquid is used to decolorize the polyester fabric, and the second functional ionic liquid is used to depolymerize the polyester fabric.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Method of depolymerising phenolic polymers
abstract: The invention provides a method for depolymerising a phenolic polymer, the method comprising reacting the phenolic polymer with dimethylsulphoxide (DMSO) and a hydrogen halide. The phenolic polymer may be selected from the group consisting of lignin and derivatives thereof. The hydrogen halide may be HBr. The quantity of hydrogen halide per gram of phenolic polymer may be from 30 mmoles to 70 mmoles. The quantity of DMSO per gram of phenolic polymer may be from 0.1 mole to 1 mole. The reaction may be performed at a temperature of from 100 to 120° C. The reaction may be carried out for between 10 h and 14 h. The product of the reaction may comprise vanillin.

title: Means and methods for modifying trichothecene
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for modifying a trichothecene, a mutant variant of a polypeptide, an additive, methods for manufacturing, a use of the polypeptide, a polynucleotide, a recombinant host cell, and a polypeptide for use in treatment, amelioration and/or prophylaxis of symptoms caused by mycotoxicosis.

title: Cellulose powder and method for producing the same
abstract: To provide a method for producing cellulose powder using a base material including cellulose without using an acid catalyst such as sulfuric acid or strong base ionized water, and provide cellulose powder.SOLUTION: The present invention relates to a method for producing cellulose powder using a base material including cellulose, including the steps of: irradiating the base material including cellulose; and crushing the cellulose in the irradiated base material. This invention also relates to a cellulose powder, wherein, a water-absorbing compound is chemically bonded to the cellulose powder.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Dynamic power rail floating for cdac circuits
abstract: Techniques are described to address P-MOS bias temperature instability (BTI) stress issues within capacitive radio frequency digital-to-analog converter (CDAC) using a circuit architecture solution that functions to protect the transistors in various operating conditions. Techniques are disclosed that function to float one or both of the negative and positive power supply rail voltages higher or lower, respectively, for CDAC cells depending upon various operating scenarios. These scenarios include the transmitting state of individual CDAC cells and the transmitting state of the CDAC array in which the CDAC cell is implemented.

title: Switching circuit
abstract: In one embodiment, an impedance matching network includes a variable reactance circuit having fixed reactance components and corresponding switching circuits. Each switching circuit includes a diode and a driver circuit. The driver circuit includes, coupled in series, a biasing current source positioned to provide a bias current to bias the diode, a first switch, a second switch, and a resistor. For each diode of each switching circuit, the control circuit is configured to receive a value related to a voltage drop on the resistor and, based on the value related to the voltage drop, adjust the bias current being provided by the biasing current source.

title: Tracker module
abstract: A tracker module is provided that includes an integrated circuit on or in a module laminate, and external connection terminals including first and second external connection terminals. The integrated circuit includes a switch included in a pre-regulator circuit, a switch included in a switched-capacitor circuit, a switch included in a supply modulator, a first IC terminal connected to the first external connection terminal, and a second IC terminal connected to the second external connection terminal. The first external connection terminal is connected to a power inductor that is disposed outside the tracker module. The second external connection terminal is an input terminal for a digital control signal for the supply modulator. A distance between the first external connection terminal and the first IC terminal is shorter than a distance between the second external connection terminal and the second IC terminal.

title: Signal processing device
abstract: To provide a signal processing device capable of restricting its manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A signal processing device 1 is configured including: a signal processing part 2 at least having a first operational amplifier 41 and a second operational amplifier 42; a first switch 51 for changing the connection between a signal source and a first non-inverting input terminal 410, and between a reference voltage VCOM and the first non-inverting input terminal 410; a second switch 52 for changing the connection between the signal source and a second non-inverting input terminal 420 and between the reference voltage VCOM and the second non-inverting input terminal 420; and a control part 7 for defining an offset amount 72 of a first processing signal S5a based on a second processing signal S5b outputted from the signal processing part 2 by the connection of the reference voltage VCOM, the first non-inverting input terminal 410, and the second non-inverting input terminal 420, due to the changes of the first switch 51 and the second switch 52.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Multi-mode oscillation circuitry with stepping control
abstract: An apparatus is disclosed for implementing multi-mode oscillation circuitry with stepping control. In an example aspect, the multi-mode oscillation circuitry comprises a resonator coupled to a first oscillator and a second oscillator. The multi-mode oscillation circuitry is configured to selectively be in a first configuration with the first oscillator in an active state and the second oscillator in an inactive state or a second configuration with the first oscillator in the inactive state and the second oscillator in the active state. The apparatus also includes a step-control circuit coupled to the multi-mode oscillation circuitry. The step-control circuit is configured to cause the first oscillator to switch from the inactive state to the active state and incrementally increase a first gain of the first oscillator based on the first oscillator being in the active state to enable the multi-mode oscillation circuitry to transition from the second configuration to the first configuration.

title: Belt for papermaking and method for producing belt for papermaking
abstract: [Problem] To provide a belt which is for papermaking and in which a resin in a resin layer is inhibited from coming off during use, and a method for producing the belt for papermaking. [Solution] A belt for papermaking according to an embodiment of the present invention is to be used in a paper-making machine, and has at least one resin layer containing a resin. The total number of bulges having a height of at least 50 μm and cracks having a length of at least 10 mm is at most 1.0/m 2 in at least one surface of the resin layer. A belt for papermaking according to another embodiment of the present invention is to be used in a paper-making machine, and has at least one resin layer containing a resin. The resin layer is formed using a resin composition containing an aqueous urethane resin dispersion. The resin composition contains an organic solvent having a boiling point of 100°C or higher under a pressure of 1 atm.

title: Pressure-sensitive adhesive composition, pressure-sensitive adhesive film, optical film with pressure-sensitive adhesive layer, liquid crystal panel
abstract: To provide: a pressure-sensitive adhesive composition which can make excellent antistatic performance and durability including pressure-sensitive adhesive performance compatible with each other; a pressure-sensitive adhesive film; an optical film with a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer; and a liquid crystal panel.SOLUTION: A pressure-sensitive adhesive composition is provided which comprises an acrylic polymer, an antistatic agent, and a cross-linking agent. The acrylic polymer has a glass transition temperature of 0°C or less. The cross-linking agent is one or more selected from the group consisting of tri- or more functional isocyanate compounds and di- or more functional epoxy compounds. The pressure-sensitive adhesive composition does not contain a plasticizer and includes a silane coupling agent of a monomer type having at least one functional group selected from an epoxy group, a mercapto group, and an acid anhydride group or of an oligomer type. The antistatic agent is an ionic compound having a melting point of 25°C or more, wherein the anion is one selected from a trifluoromethanesulfonate anion, a pentafluoroethanesulfonate anion, a heptafluoropropanesulfonate anion, and a nonafluorobutanesulfonate anion.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Ethylenic modifier, ethylenic resin composition, film, method for producing ethylenic resin composition, and method for producing film
abstract: To provide an ethylenic modifier which enables formation of a film that is excellent in slipperiness and is relatively reduced in fish eyes.SOLUTION: An ethylenic modifier has a strain hardening index determined by an LAOS method of 0.27 or more and 0.53 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Thermal spraying slurry and aggregation inhibitor used for the same
abstract: To provide a thermal spraying slurry that inhibits aggregate from being generated even when being stored for a long term.SOLUTION: A thermal spraying slurry includes thermal spraying powder, a solvent, and an aggregation inhibitor including a triazine compound.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Release film for transfer mold and method for manufacturing semiconductor chip encapsulation
abstract: To provide: a release film for a transfer mold which is capable of imparting excellent designability and has excellent moldability during molding process and excellent residual reduction after peeling off the release film; and a method for manufacturing a semiconductor chip encapsulation.SOLUTION: A release film for a semiconductor transfer mold is made up of a base material layer and a release layer, and includes the release layer on at least a surface of one side. The base material layer contains 0.1-30 mass% of particles.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Method and device for dynamic switching between downlink data channel transmission or reception schemes in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting higher data transfer rates. Specifically, the present discourse provides a method of receiving, by a terminal, transmission configuration indicator (TCI) state information in a wireless communication system, the method comprising the steps of: receiving information on a TCI state from a base station; obtaining a parameter relating to at least one of an uplink transmission beam and a downlink reception beam on the basis of the received information on the TCI state; and transmitting or receiving data to or from the base station on the basis of the determined parameter.

title: Techniques for precoding air-to-air sidelink communications
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A first user equipment (UE) may receive a message indicating geographic location information related to beamforming an air-to-air sidelink message via a sidelink channel. In some examples, a second UE may transmit the message or a base station may transmit the message. The message may be the same or different as a message scheduling the sidelink message. The geographic location information may be geographic location information associated with the second UE, geographic location information associated with one or more directions to avoid when beamforming the sidelink message, or a combination thereof. The first UE may identify one or more precoding parameters based on the geographic location information. The first UE may transmit the air-to-air sidelink message to the second UE. The sidelink message may be precoded for transmission via a transmission beam using the one or more precoding parameters.

title: Adaptation of spatial reuse for extremely high throughput
abstract: This disclosure describes systems, methods, and devices related to spatial reuse for extremely high throughput (EHT). A device may identify a frame received from a first station device configured to operate in a first basic service set (BSS) on a first channel. The device may analyze a preamble of the frame to determine a classification of the frame. The device may adjust a calculation of a packet detection for overlapping basic service set (OBSS) value based on a number of unpunctured 20 MHz frequency channels. The device may determine to simultaneously use the first channel for communication with a second device within a second BSS based on the calculation of the packet detection for OBSS value.

title: Method and device for adjusting multi pannels based on network assistance for inter-ue communication
abstract: An operation method of a first device 100 in wireless communication system is proposed. The method may comprise: receiving, from a second device 200 , information for first spatial setting; obtaining second spatial setting related to a second beam which does not cover a first beam related to the first spatial setting; and performing, to a third device 300 , an inter-device transmission based on the second spatial setting.

title: Terminal and control method thereof in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or pre-5G communication system for supporting higher data transfer rates than that of a beyond 4G communication system such as LTE. A control method of a terminal in a wireless communication system, according to an embodiment of the present invention, may comprise the steps of: receiving radio resource control signaling (RRC signaling) for a signal measured by a terminal; identifying a transmission interval of a signal measured by the terminal, on the basis of the received RRC signaling; identifying first information for forming a predetermined beam; and determining whether to change the first information for forming a beam to second information for forming a beam, on the basis of the identified transmission interval.

title: Map information providing system, map information providing method, and map information providing program
abstract: To provide information with minimal deviation from the current situation.SOLUTION: A map information providing system comprises: an administrator information storage unit which stores information about administrators who have the authority to generate an object; a generation permission unit which permits the input of object information used to generate an object using the administrator information; a worker information storage unit which stores information about a worker who performs tasks in an area on a real space equivalent to the object; an input permission unit which permits the input of status information indicative of the status of the object with respect to the worker's terminal using the worker information; a display determination unit which determines the display of the object in the map using the status information input to the worker's terminal; and a display control unit which causes a map including the object whose display has been determined by the display determination unit to be displayed on the user's terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: system
abstract: A system according to an embodiment aims to suggest personalized smartphone plans based on customer needs and usage patterns.SOLUTION: A system includes a collection part, an analysis part, a proposal part, an interaction part, an analysis part, and an introduction part. The collection unit collects information on a customer. The analysis unit analyzes the information collected by the collection unit and determines the needs and usage patterns of the customer. The proposal unit proposes a personalized smartphone plan based on the determination result obtained by the analysis unit. The interaction unit performs interaction with the customer on the basis of the plan proposed by the proposal unit. The analysis unit analyzes the use state of the customer based on the information obtained by the interaction unit, and proposes an appropriate plan or upgrade. The introduction unit introduces a new function or service based on the result obtained by the analysis unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Methods, devices and systems for acquiring service, executing operation, and transmitting information
abstract: Embodiments of the present application relate to a method, device, and system for obtaining service, executing operations, and offline physical equipment-based information transmission. The method includes obtaining, by a terminal, identifying information associated with a provision device, communicating, by the terminal, the identifying information to an identifying information receiver, obtaining, by the terminal, provision information associated with the provision device, wherein the provision information is obtained as feedback by the identifying information receiver based on the identifying information, and wherein the provision information is indicative of at least one service or one product provided by the provision device, and providing, by the terminal, at least a subset of the provision information associated with the provision device to a user of the terminal.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract: To provide a technique for generating more efficient position information according to a purpose.SOLUTION: A data acquisition unit 52 obtains first type data that is used to generate position information of an object, which is specified by a predetermined generation method for generating position information. A position information generation unit 53 generates the position information of the object by executing generation processing of the position information using the first type data according to the predetermined generation method. A purpose result estimation unit 54 estimates a result for a predetermined purpose of the object, based on the position information of the object. A method selection unit 51 selects, based on the purpose, the predetermined generation method used by the data acquisition unit 52 and the position information generation unit 53 from among N kinds (N is an integer equal to or greater than 2) of generation methods for generating the position information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: system
abstract: To provide a system comprising an AI butler that cannot only deal with what can be done digitally but also be a conversation partner or a game opponent.SOLUTION: Provided is a system comprising an AI butler that cannot only deal with what can be done digitally but also be a conversation partner or a game opponent.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Computational heuristic encoder enhancement relay system
abstract: Methods and systems for filtering a trigger signal from an encoder (120) for triggering an image capturing device (140). In embodiments, a trigger signal may be received as an input signal from an encoder (120) including a sequence of pulses for triggering the image capturing device (140). In embodiments, an average pulse frequency of the trigger signal over a period of time may be determined based on sampling a number of pulses in the trigger signal over the period of time, and frequency restrictions may be applied to the average pulse frequency to generate a trigger frequency. In embodiments, an output frequency may be determined based on the trigger frequency, and a pulse width modulation, PWM, signal having a frequency based on the output frequency may be determined for triggering the image capturing device.

title: Non-crosslinked heat shrink tubing
abstract: A non-crosslinked polymeric heat shrink tubing including poly(ether-block-amide) (PEBA) and methods for making such non-crosslinked polymeric heat shrink tubing is provided. The non-crosslinked PEBA heat shrink tubing disclosed herein finds application, e.g., as a processing aid and final component in the manufacture of catheters and other medical devices.

title: Image forming apparatus and image forming method
abstract: An image forming apparatus includes an image forming portion, an image reading portion, and a test processing portion. The image forming portion forms an image on a sheet using a plurality of recording elements. The image reading portion reads the image on the sheet. The test processing portion causes the image forming portion to form a test image in a marginal region of the sheet, and causes the image reading portion to read the test image. The test processing portion is capable of executing a divisional test in which only some of the plurality of recording elements are used for forming a single test image to be formed on a single sheet and all of the plurality of recording elements are used for forming a test image group constituted of a plurality of the test images to be formed on a plurality of the sheets.

title: Gasoline-electric hybrid power vehicle, control method, computer device and readable storage medium
abstract: A gasoline-electric hybrid power vehicle, a control method, a computer device and a readable storage medium. The method comprising: detecting an ambient noise value; obtaining the total noise of noise generated by the vehicle at a current position after superposition of the ambient noise; comparing the total noise to determine whether the total noise meets a requirement of a preset noise limit value; when the requirement is not met, adjusting the rotating speed of an internal combustion engine of a gasoline drive system, reducing the noise generated by the vehicle, so as to enable the operation of the vehicle to always meet the requirement of the preset noise limit value; and when the rotating speed of the internal combustion engine is reduced to reduce the noise, increasing the power of an electric drive system to a certain extent, so as to maintain normal running of the vehicle.

title: Apparatus and method for assigning material value score to printed circuit board waste material or portion thereof and system for sorting printed circuit board waste material
abstract: To provide an apparatus and a method for assigning a material value score to a printed circuit board waste material or a portion thereof, and a system for sorting the printed circuit board waste material.SOLUTION: An apparatus is configured to determine a material value score and to perform the determination on the basis of a dual energy or spectral X-ray image of a printed circuit board waste material 200 or a portion 210 thereof. Furthermore, the apparatus is configured to perform the determination by applying the dual energy or spectral X-ray image to a machine learning module.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
